name: nvim
description: Modern Vim-based terminal editor with Lua configuration, LSP support, and advanced editing capabilities

tools.description: Modern terminal-based text editor with Lua configuration, LSP integration, tree-sitter syntax highlighting, and extensible plugin system
tools.usage:
nvim file.txt # Edit a file with syntax highlighting and LSP features
nvim -c 'set number' file.py # Open file with line numbers enabled
nvim -O file1.js file2.js # Open multiple files in vertical splits
nvim -d file1.txt file2.txt # Compare files in diff mode
nvim +/pattern file.log # Open file and jump to first occurrence of pattern
nvim -c ':Tutor' # Launch built-in interactive tutorial
nvim --headless -c 'echo "hello"' -c 'qall' # Run headless for scripting
nvim -u NONE -N file.txt # Start with no configuration (clean slate)

tools.description: Hex dump utility for viewing and analyzing binary files in hexadecimal format with ASCII representation
tools.usage:
xxd binary_file.exe # Display hex dump of executable file
xxd -l 256 file.bin # Show only first 256 bytes
xxd -g 4 data.bin # Group bytes in sets of 4
xxd -r hex_dump.txt > restored.bin # Reverse hex dump back to binary
xxd -i firmware.bin > firmware.h # Generate C array header file
xxd -p -c 16 file.dat # Plain hex output, 16 bytes per line
echo 'Hello World' | xxd # Hex dump from stdin
xxd -s 0x1000 -l 512 large_file.bin # Skip to offset and read 512 bytes

tools.description: Windows clipboard integration utility providing seamless copy/paste functionality for terminal applications like Vim and Neovim
tools.usage:
echo 'Hello World' | win32yank -i # Copy text to Windows clipboard
win32yank -o # Paste from Windows clipboard to stdout
win32yank -i --crlf # Copy with Windows line endings
win32yank -o --lf # Paste with Unix line endings
echo 'Multi-line\nText' | win32yank -i # Copy multiline text
win32yank --version # Display version information
